clue.text: Beams, though put off by snub

parts.note: to put off a coat or skin is to cast it off, shed it
a snub is a slight, a deliberate insult

explanation.surface: Someone smiles broadly even though they have just been brushed aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beams' looks like a smile but is a verb: to beam is to give out rays.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that beams sends out rays and so illuminates, the literal sense of the phrase.

parts.note: a male person is referred to as he

explanation.surface: A man in charge of a newspaper hands in his resignation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Giving notice' suggests resigning; 'notice' alone is the verb meaning pay attention to.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice something, in the sense of taking note of it, is to pay it attention.

definitions.meaning: a sap is a fool, a simpleton

explanation.surface: Narcotics extracted from the juice of a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slang: narcotics are called by this word, and so is a stupid person.

clue.text: Liquid preparation which requires no toil

indicators.note: the preparation requires the letters of the following words to be worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A soothing liquid you can use without any effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'requires' signals that NO TOIL is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream or lotion-style liquid is a medicinal or cosmetic preparation applied to the skin.

clue.text: Craftsman famous for carving a smile on fish and animals

parts.note: a grin is a broad smile
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family
gibbons are small apes

explanation.surface: A sculptor famed for carving a grinning face onto figures of fish and beasts.
explanation.walkthrough: Grinling Gibbons (1648-1721) was the great English woodcarver of St Paul's Cathedral and many country houses.
explanation.definitionFit: The man named was a seventeenth-century master woodcarver, the most celebrated in English history.

clue.text: A suppressed laugh can involve a non-drinker in a row

indicators.note: the row is made to involve, that is to enclose, the abstainer

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
TT means teetotal, a person who drinks no alcohol

explanation.surface: Stifled giggling may land a teetotaller in a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' suggests a quarrel; here it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A titter is a nervous, half-stifled giggle.

clue.text: The flower that's sent top men wild

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters of the preceding words run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A bloom so striking it drove the leading men into a frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges SENT TOP MEN into the flower's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Penstemon, also spelt this way, is a garden plant with tubular foxglove-like blooms.

clue.text: A portion of cheese can cause some discomfort

indicators.note: only a portion of the word cheese, its opening letters, is taken

explanation.surface: Even a small piece of cheese can bring on indigestion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'portion of' takes CHE from the start of 'cheese', after A.
explanation.definitionFit: A dull continuous pain is a form of discomfort.

parts.note: to con is to read or study carefully
on means about, concerning
worker ants are the classic crossword workers

explanation.surface: Someone peruses the labourers' correspondence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' suggests mail but means letters of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Of the alphabet's letters, all except the vowels belong to this group.

clue.text: Go into detail about the Right when put out

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: to expatiate is to speak or write at length
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone elaborates on right-wing views after being thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts R inside EXPATIATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An exile, someone banished or put out of their own country, is so called.

indicators.note: in shows the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: An insect that is naturally dressed for the part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters lurking across 'clothinG NATurally'.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnat is a small two-winged insect, a kind of fly.

definitions.meaning: a date is an appointment to meet
a promise to wed, a betrothal

explanation.surface: An appointment that seals a wedding agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both an arranged appointment and a formal promise to wed.

definitions.meaning: a pitman is a coal miner
John ... was a Victorian portrait painter

explanation.surface: A mine worker who is also an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A coal miner goes by this name, as did the English artist of Lady Godiva.

clue.text: Body discovered in crate under a vehicle!

indicators.note: in a down answer the crate piece is placed under, after, the vehicle

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle
a case is a crate or box

explanation.surface: A corpse is found in a packing crate beneath a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' sets CASE beneath CAR in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead animal's body is a carcass, older spelling as here.

parts.note: re means about, concerning
three of the four quarters, compass points, North, East and West

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word is dropped

explanation.surface: A fix that is roughly three-quarters, nearly complete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three-quarters' are three cardinal points, N, E, W; 'almost' trims ALL to AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Restoration or mending of something is its renewal.

indicators.note: two tells us to take the following word's equivalent twice

parts.note: can means may, be allowed to

explanation.surface: A couple are allowed to dance as partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may' looks like a verb of permission in the surface and so it is: CAN, doubled.
explanation.definitionFit: The French high-kicking chorus routine is a well-known dance.

clue.text: Flighty creature taking a measure proving to be a bloomer

parts.note: a cuckoo is a bird, a creature of flight
a pint is a measure of liquid

explanation.surface: A scatty person who has taken a drink turns out to be a blunderer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bloomer' suggests a mistake; it means a flowering plant. Cuckoo-pint is the wild arum, lords-and-ladies.
explanation.definitionFit: Wild arum is a woodland plant that flowers, so a bloomer in the cryptic sense.

definitions.meaning: a still is apparatus for distilling, as is a glass vessel with a long neck

explanation.surface: Even now someone is demanding a reply.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a distilling flask used in labs and a quick witty reply.

clue.text: Trying Cannes, go in March maybe

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Attempting a trip to the film festival town in early spring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges the letters of CANNES GO IN MARCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a risk on something is an attempt, a try, in British idiom.

parts.note: an ode is a poem, lines of verse

indicators.note: backing means the following piece is read from end to start

parts.note: the number points to the clue 3-down, whose answer means a fool, here a donkey-word for a fool

explanation.surface: Verses written in support of a drug-related piece, composed in Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: The number '3' is a cross-reference: read it as the word that 3-down's answer stands for in the 'fool' sense. Odessa, now in Ukraine, was a city of Soviet Russia when the puzzle was set.
explanation.definitionFit: The Black Sea port was a city of Russia, then the Soviet Union, when the puzzle appeared.

parts.note: aye is an old word for always, ever
aye is a vote in favour

explanation.surface: Constantly back the ape.
explanation.walkthrough: The aye-aye is a Madagascan lemur.
explanation.definitionFit: A nocturnal lemur of Madagascar is a primate.

parts.note: a gig is a light two-wheeled carriage, a cart
taken as written

explanation.surface: A concert appearing on television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the box' suggests television; 'Gig' is a horse-drawn carriage, not a concert.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardboard container is a kind of box.

parts.note: reads as a place of poor service, but the unwell are the people who get medical treatment there

explanation.definitionFit: A medical centre where outpatients who are ill receive care.

parts.note: describes something that looks and is spherical: the organ of sight

explanation.definitionFit: The spherical organ of sight is literally a round thing that looks.

clue.text: Sound support will be given by a member of the Upper House

definitions.text: a member of the Upper House

indicators.note: sound signals the next word is replaced by one said the same way

parts.note: a pier is a supporting pillar

explanation.surface: Solid backing will be provided by a lord.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'solid' but signals the homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: Lords sitting in the British upper chamber are nobles, members of the peerage.

indicators.note: in a down answer, up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sip is a small drink

explanation.surface: Having a drink upstairs somewhere in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns A SIP to give the Italian town of the Leaning Tower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tuscan town with the leaning tower.

parts.note: G is a musical key
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: An important bugging device is part of the kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' suggests important; it is the musical key of G.
explanation.definitionFit: Kit or apparatus for a job is called gear.

clue.text: Dressing many a one is awkward

indicators.note: being awkward suggests the letters are clumsily shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Many a person finds getting dressed difficult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is awkward' rearranges MANY A ONE; 'Dressing' is a salad dressing, not putting on clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: The egg-and-oil sauce is a salad dressing.

clue.text: A record produced when school's over

indicators.note: over means the word is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public (private) school near Windsor

explanation.surface: Something written down when term finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns ETON round.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief written record, such as a memo, is a note.

parts.note: easy means simple
airs are tunes, music

explanation.surface: Plain hymn tunes are part of the décor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Furnishing' suggests decor but means items of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfortable armchairs are articles of furniture, furnishings.
